args.root_cause: In calculate_tax, the tax amount is quantized to cents with rounding=ROUND_DOWN (truncation) instead of half-up rounding. Whenever the exact tax has a fractional-cent part at or above .5 cent (e.g. 10.00 * 0.0725 = 0.7250 -> should be 0.73, but truncates to 0.72), the result is one cent low. Orders whose tax is not on a half-cent boundary truncate to the same value as rounding, which is why most orders match. The test file already expects ROUND_HALF_UP behavior (its comments state "rounds half up"). Note that ROUND_DOWN is imported from decimal and used on line 20 of library/tax.py.
